title: Sketches at IMC
content: Quick post to let you know that I am at Illustration Master Class in Amherst, Massachusetts, where a group of 95 artists work on a college campus for a week to create a fantasy painting under the guidance of the full-time faculty and guest lecturers.Here's Mo Willems, children's book writer and illustrator, who gave a talk about his book, which includeA Big Guy Took My Ball!.We were also treated to a talk by New Yorker illustrator and character designer Peter de Sève. He told the story how he got started as an illustrator and found his way to his movie design work.-----Previously:Illustration Master Class 2011Book:A Sketchy Past: The Art of Peter de SeveMo WillemsA Big Guy Took My Ball!Illustration Master Class
